entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'd like to start a return for an order I received a few days ago.
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your name and order number, please?
Of course. The name is Alex Miller, order number 774-B31-901.
Thank you, Alex. I see the order here for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. It looks like it was delivered five days ago. To process this correctly, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the helmet?
It's just the color. The 'Solar Flare Red' on the website looked much brighter. In person, it's more of a muted orange, and I'm not a fan. The box is still unopened, so it's in perfect condition.
I understand. Sometimes the lighting in photos can be a bit different. So it's just a preference on the color, not a technical fault?
Correct. The helmet itself seems fine, but for visibility and safety, I really wanted a more vibrant color. This one won't work for me.

No problem at all. Let me just check our policy... Okay, I see here that you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve that return for a full refund for you. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label right now.

That's great, thank you. Before you do, I was looking at the 'Volt Yellow' version of the same helmet. Instead of a refund, would it be possible to get a discount code to apply towards that new purchase? Maybe to compensate for the inconvenience of the color being off?

That's a fair question, Alex. I see that you're one of our VIP members. While I can't offer a discount on the exchange itself, for your loyalty I can add a 15% off coupon to your account that you can use on the new helmet or any future order. How does that sound?
A 15% coupon works perfectly. That's a great solution. Thank you, Sarah.

You're very welcome. I've just sent the return label for the first helmet to your email on file, and I've applied that 15% credit to your VeloFit account. It will show up automatically at checkout. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been very helpful.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
